UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's profile within the AnimaVet AI application, linked to an external authentication system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity. This typically corresponds to the user ID from an external authentication system.

displayName.description: A user-friendly name to display for the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

Pet.title: Pet
Pet.description: Represents a pet registered by a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Pet entity.

species.description: The species of the pet (e.g., dog, cat).

age.description: The age of the pet in years.

imageUrl.description: A placeholder image URL for the pet.

AnalysisRequest.title: AnalysisRequest
AnalysisRequest.description: Records details of an AI analysis request, including user input and the AI's generated response.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AnalysisRequest entity.

requestType.description: The type of analysis requested, either 'text' for textual descriptions or 'image' for visual input.

textInput.description: The textual description provided by the user for analysis (if requestType is 'text').

imageUrl.description: A URL or reference to the image provided by the user for analysis (if requestType is 'image').

analysisOutput.description: The complete response generated by the AI based on the analysis.

requestedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the analysis request was made.

responseLanguage.description: The language in which the AI response was generated (e.g., 'pt-BR').

definition.description: Subcollection storing pets belonging to a user.
Subcollection of AI analysis requests specific to a user.
